name: MonarchScoreRing
title: ScoreRing
summary: A circular score: an arc filled to the value out of the maximum, with the number always written in the center.
whenToUse: For one score on a known scale that people compare against bands, such as a health score out of 100 or an average rating out of 5.
whenNotToUse: For progress of a task, use MonarchProgress. For a value against a target with ranges, use MonarchGauge. For a percentage of a quota, use MonarchUsageMeter.
api: @Composable fun MonarchScoreRing(value: Double?, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, color: MonarchScoreRingColor = MonarchScoreRingColor.Auto, size: MonarchScoreRingSize = MonarchScoreRingSize.Md, max: Double = 100.0, thresholds: List<MonarchScoreRingThreshold> = MonarchScoreRingThreshold.Defaults, showMax: Boolean? = null, label: String? = null, description: String? = null, format: ((Double) -> String)? = null, labels: MonarchScoreRingLabels = MonarchScoreRingLabels())
sealed interface MonarchScoreRingColor { data object Auto; data object Accent; data class Tone(val tone: MonarchTone) }
enum class MonarchScoreRingSize { Sm, Md, Lg }
data class MonarchScoreRingThreshold(val minimum: Double, val tone: MonarchTone) { companion object { val Defaults: List<MonarchScoreRingThreshold> } }
class MonarchScoreRingLabels(name: String? = null, valueText: ((value: String, max: String) -> String)? = null, ofMax: ((max: String) -> String)? = null, noValue: String? = null)

options.name: value
options.description: The score. null or not a number shows an empty ring and a dash. Limited to 0 through max.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the ring and its texts.

options.name: color
options.description: Auto takes the tone of the band; Accent is the brand color for a score with no good or bad meaning; Tone(tone) is fixed.

options.name: size
options.description: Sm 48, Md 80, Lg 120dp at the default font size; the ring grows with the font size setting.

options.name: max
options.description: The top of the scale. Zero, negative or infinite values fall back to 100.

options.name: thresholds
options.description: The bands Auto uses: 80 success, 60 info, 40 warning, below 40 danger.

options.name: showMax
options.description: Shows "/ 100" under the number. null shows it on Md and Lg.

options.name: label
options.description: Shown under the ring and read as its name.

options.name: description
options.description: A second line under the label, read after the name.

options.name: format
options.description: Formats the number in the center and in the spoken value. null writes the whole number in the current locale.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for "Score" (monarch_scorering_name), "78 out of 100" (monarch_scorering_value), "/ 100" (monarch_scorering_of_max) and "No score yet" (monarch_scorering_no_value).

states.name: scored
states.description: The arc is filled to the share of the maximum and the number is written in the center; the arc changes with a short animation, or at once when animations are off.

states.name: no score
states.description: An empty track, a dash in the center and the spoken state "No score yet"; the auto color is neutral.

appearance: The arc takes the solid color of the tone and the number its strong color on the muted background track; the accent color uses the accent solid and strong roles; the neutral tone uses muted text for the arc. The number is semibold, about a third of the diameter; "/ 100" and the description are muted caption text. The same roles in every theme, including both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web takes the diameter and stroke width in pixels; here three sizes keep the ring on the spacing scale and the ring grows with the font size setting, so the number always fits. The web accent tone is the Accent case of MonarchScoreRingColor, because MonarchTone has no accent tone. The web exposes a meter role; Compose has none, so the range is progress information with the spoken value as the state description. iOS shares the name and the options.
accessibility: The ring, number, label and description are one TalkBack element: the name is the label (or "Score") followed by the description, the state is "78 out of 100".
The range 0 to the maximum and the score are exposed as progress information.
Without a score the state is "No score yet" and there is no range.
The score is always written as a number, so the color of the band is never the only signal.
The ring grows with the font size setting so the number is not cut off at the largest size.
edgeCases: Values above the maximum or below zero are limited; NaN shows no score.
A custom format that writes long text can be wider than the Sm ring; keep it short.
Empty thresholds give the neutral tone for every score.

examples.title: Bands
A rating out of 5 in the accent color
examples.code:
MonarchScoreRing(
    value = 4.2,
    max = 5.0,
    color = MonarchScoreRingColor.Accent,
    size = MonarchScoreRingSize.Sm,
    label = "Average rating",
    format = { "%.1f".format(it) },
)
